text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Finished the wave running.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you were running nice and relaxed out there.
Yeah, you were running nice and relaxed out there, weren't you?

text_block_list.text:
Wave running is training where you raise
and lower your speed like a wave.
You alternate between sprinting and relaxed running.

I am training my body to remember
to run while staying relaxed whenever needed.

It's difficult to build endurance
at this stage, while your body is still developing.

To last the full 1,600m,
it's much safer to conserve stamina.

Calstone Light O was able to run the wave drill smoothly,
controlling her pace with good rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Adding some relaxed running in between made it easier to sprint at full power.
choice_data_list: When you relax, you can run with good form
When you relax, you can run with good form, you know

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. You did mention that at the beginning.
That form is what's most important.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, maintaining proper form is difficult.
It doesn't come easily to me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even though I do mental training every day.
Before I go to sleep, and even in my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was doing image training in my dream.
Though it seems I was running in reality as well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Durandal gave me a thorough scolding.
She said rustling around in bed was scary.
You were moving your legs like you were running while asleep? That's scary. I told her to take it easy on the mental training.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Please check my form.

Whether due to the mental training or not, Calstone Light O
recorded a personal best at 1600m.

Heading into the Asahi Hai FS,
everything went so smoothly it felt almost too good to be true.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...... Pheeew.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: The lap times were—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
............
There's a gap between how my run felt and the actual time...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No good at all.
One more time...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'll keep going until I can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"So Jungle Pocket and Agnes Tachyon went to the
'Hopeful Stakes', huh.
In that case, I wonder who'll win the 'Asahi Hai FS'."

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it gonna be that girl after all?
She's already considered a top contender for the Classic Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I choose Calstone Light O! Her run in the Make Debut was truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You say you sensed her potential?
With legs like those, I bet she runs insanely fast.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am happy.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy, I can't thank you enough.
I'm going to go express my gratitude for a moment, okay?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Excuse me, miss! Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kya! Wh-What?
Wait, Calstone Light O? The real one?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Calstone Light O here.
I will without fail show you what maximum speed running looks like.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Top-speed running, is it?
To boast so boldly during the Junior Class period,
you must be progressing exceptionally well.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just because I haven't debuted yet
doesn't mean I plan to idly pass the time.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As a knight,
one must always keep their blade sharp.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I wish you the best of luck in today's race, Light O-san.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
May you perform to the absolute best of your abilities.
—Excuse me, then.

"Indeed, Calstone Light O has managed to make it
this far smoothly. We'll want to keep
that momentum going today."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. Apologies,
we're running a bit behind schedule. Let's hurry.

On the same day, in a race before the Asahi Hai FS,
she took to the track.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Number 12 leaps out into the lead here!
Pulling away straight through the wire! The winner is—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa...... damn it!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I wasn't nearly skilled enough...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's no better than amateur work.
...All I can do is put in the effort.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—It is finally time.
Now, let us go.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go break my top speed record!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. I am the fastest Umamusume!
